The results refer to retrospective forecasts for the 2025/26 season.
:::

The probabilistic evaluation compares the QRA ensemble with the probabilistic baseline model. Lower **WIS** is better. **WIS skill** above zero means that the QRA improves on the baseline; a value below zero means that the baseline performs better.

Coverage rates for the 50%, 80% and 95% intervals are available in the complete [results file on GitHub](https://github.com/philipgerlee/swedish_forecasting_hub/blob/main/evaluation-output/2025-2026/probabilistic-comparison-by-location-horizon.csv).

## Interpretation

WIS rewards accurate forecasts while also penalising unnecessarily wide prediction intervals. A separate metric for interval width is therefore not required. Results from a single retrospective season should be interpreted cautiously and do not, by themselves, demonstrate general model performance.
